name: hhc
description: HHC (Human Hunter Check) — a local-first self-triage tool to assess whether a job/headhunting approach is a foreign-intelligence recruitment attempt. Outputs a risk band + recommended action; never a verdict.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p agent/tsconfig.json
scripts.serve: npm run build && HHC_SERVE_WEB=1 HHC_AUTH=1 npm run start --workspace agent
